rows.remaining: This row proves the pinned DXC target progression and PSO linking for the synthetic corpus; it does not claim exhaustive opcode or stage coverage.

The SM5.0 vertex/geometry/pixel chain returns exactly 1,352 nonzero pixels and center pixel 0xff407e81. Broader geometry topology, resource, stream-output, adjacency, and multi-stage combinations remain in the exhaustive row.

The SM5 DXBC/AIR geometry provider executes two emitted strips with RestartStrip and SV_PrimitiveID, and a source-staged two-instance dcl_gsinstances variant returns distinct exact RGBA readbacks through SV_GSInstanceID. Broader instance counts, DXIL geometry-provider ABI, and broader topology/resource/adjacency combinations remain open.

The SM5.0 vertex/hull/domain/pixel chain with integer partitioning, triangle topology, three control points, and factor one returns exactly 1,352 nonzero pixels and center pixel 0xff407e81 while exercising OutputControlPointID/input-patch loads, patch-constant stores, and DomainLocation interpolation. The separate bounded patch-constant proof closes the exact 0.25 SV_InsideTessFactor form; broader patch layouts, partitioning, topology, factors, resources, and state remain in the exhaustive row.

The bounded native tessellation proof consumes an exact 0.25 SV_InsideTessFactor value in the domain shader and returns the corresponding 0xff000040 center pixel. It promotes the LoadPatchConstant row only for this explicit proof profile; arbitrary patch-constant layouts, factors, partitioning, topology, resources, and general HS/DS bytecode remain fail-closed.

The exact semantic readback set covers arithmetic, hyperbolic/normal math, msad4, SM6.4 dot2add and signed/unsigned dot4add packed accumulation, pack/unpack 4x8 signed/unsigned truncation and clamp modes, SM6.9 vector-reduce-and/or, SM6.9 RawBufferVectorLoad/Store aggregate transfers, buffers, barriers, wave/quad operations, SM6.7 vector/int64 arithmetic, SM6.8 wide arithmetic, and SM6.9 float16 conversion. The core opcode lane additionally returns exact float/int/bitwise results for common unary, binary, tertiary, dot, and conversion families; SM6.9 eight- and sixteen-component long-vector lanes cover exact FDot, arithmetic, dynamic construction, xor, element addressing, VectorReduceAnd/VectorReduceOr all/any results, componentwise negation/absolute-value/complement/sqrt/rsqrt/log2/exp2/sin/cos lowering, integer and floating min/max, integer/floating tertiary mad, float/integer vector conversion and select, signed/unsigned vector division/shift/remainder, and long-vector float remainder.

The source-staged control-flow cases cover a multi-block switch, PHI merge, loop-carried aggregate state, vector aggregate extraction, and exact four-lane readback; nested-control and broader aggregate forms remain in the exhaustive row.

The parser now resolves LLVM vector element type references without self-recursion and the SM6.7/6.8 vector lanes remain exact; first-class LLVM array values and broader matrix/type lowering remain in the exhaustive row.

The source-staged atomic matrix exercises add, and, or, xor, signed/unsigned min/max, and exchange with exact old/new-value readback; 64-bit atomic resource-class breadth remains in the exhaustive row.

The source-staged vector lane proves a four-component shuffle and aggregate arithmetic across four dispatch lanes; broader vector comparisons, inserts, matrices, and aggregate memory forms remain in the exhaustive row.

The source-staged 2x2 matrix construction, row extraction, vector-matrix multiply, and aggregate arithmetic return exact [17,27,37,47]. Broader matrix dimensions, matrix memory layouts, conversions, and helper-function boundaries remain in the exhaustive row.

A source chain of three helper functions returns exact [42,66,98,138] after validated DXC entry-point optimization. Preserved DXIL library calls, exported helpers, recursion rejection, and broader parameter/result shapes remain in the exhaustive row.

The SM6.9 source-staged lanes combine uint16_t, int16_t, and float16_t arithmetic and conversions with exact [65085,65096,65107,65118] readback, and exercise float16_t sqrt/rsqrt/abs/min/max with exact result 10. Broader native-16 resource, atomic, matrix, and graphics-stage combinations remain in the exhaustive row.

The source-staged lane proves the selected double arithmetic expression through exact integer readback. Runtime-input lanes preserve the exact IEEE-754 binary64 payload 0x400921fb54442d18 through DXIL makeDouble/splitDouble and integer/double bitcasts, execute software binary64 addition/subtraction, multiplication, division, ordered/unordered comparisons, float/integer conversions, FAbs, FMin/FMax, special-value predicates, and fused multiply-add, and match exact-bit matrices covering signs, cancellation, subnormals, overflow, infinities/NaN, and round-to-nearest-even boundaries. The generated MSL binary64 helper core additionally passes a native-Metal 51-output exact-bit oracle for sqrt/rsqrt, trunc/floor/ceil, round-to-nearest-even, and frac, with no native double spelling. Direct FRem lowering uses the software remainder helper; compiler-expanded HLSL fmod and broader binary64 operation combinations remain in the exhaustive row.
Unsupported semantics are rejected instead of being promoted through placeholder MSL; implementation breadth remains tracked by the open exhaustive row.

Single external-counter compute append/consume plus vertex/pixel append semantics are exact; a directly indexed AppendStructuredBuffer heap shader compiles to DXIL and rejects PSO creation with exact E_FAIL, proving that boundary fail-closed; multi-counter and other graphics stages remain fail-closed.

The focused runtime proves compute append values 100..103 with counter 4, consume values 200..203 with counter 0, vertex append values 10..12 with counter 3, and pixel append values 0..3 with counter 4. Multi-counter, dynamically indexed counter-heap, and other graphics-stage forms remain in the exhaustive row.

The corpus links one counter UAV and rejects a two-counter shader with E_FAIL; the focused SM6.6 matrix also compiles and rejects a directly indexed counter heap with E_FAIL; non-vertex/pixel graphics-stage counters remain fail-closed.

Memory and disk-session key/value semantics, size queries, replacement, limits, missing-key errors, executable stored-compute-pipeline recreation, state-object database factory routing, pipeline descriptor version callbacks, and deep-copied application identity callback state plus collection descriptor/parent-key/version callbacks are covered. The persisted file round-trip reloads application, pipeline, and state descriptors in a fresh database instance, including fixed-size STATE_OBJECT_CONFIG, node-mask, and raytracing config payloads, RAYTRACING_PIPELINE_CONFIG1 flags, a deep-copied DXIL_LIBRARY bytecode/export payload, a deep-copied procedural HIT_GROUP string payload, a deep-copied DXIL_SUBOBJECT_TO_EXPORTS_ASSOCIATION target/export-string payload, a deep-copied SUBOBJECT_TO_EXPORTS_ASSOCIATION target index/export-string payload, both GLOBAL_SERIALIZED_ROOT_SIGNATURE and LOCAL_SERIALIZED_ROOT_SIGNATURE blobs, and EXISTING_COLLECTION_BY_KEY key/export/rename payloads; read-only stores reject with E_ACCESSDENIED and malformed files reject with ERROR_BAD_FORMAT. The Agility compiler-plugin DDI also negotiates the 1.619.5 host, reports Apple M4/ABI 1/compiler/profile version 1, and passes typed compiler-cache session group/value persistence and routing checks; compiler-object creation remains an explicit E_NOTIMPL boundary because no portable offline object-code provider is available, with no fabricated precompiled bytes. Broader compiler-session and state-object subobject combinations remain in the exhaustive row.

The focused matrix covers the current SM6.6/6.7 atomic, raw/structured descriptor indexing, texture, static and programmable offset, typed-texture, sample-compare, gather, QuadVote, root-constant provider, and SM6.8 SampleCmpGrad/SampleCmpBias cases; complete SM5.x–SM6.9 opcode/stage/resource coverage remains open.

Bounded ByteAddressBuffer[2] and StructuredBuffer<uint>[2] indexing both return exact [103,203,303,403], StructuredBuffer<uint2>[2] aggregate extraction with stride-eight addressing returns exact [303,703,303,703], nested {uint2 lo; uint2 hi;} descriptor arrays preserve stride-sixteen field extraction as [103,203,303,403], RWByteAddressBuffer[2] writes exact [503,504,505,506], RWByteAddressBuffer[4] selects descriptor three and writes [803,804,805,806], directly indexed ResourceDescriptorHeap entry three writes [903,904,905,906] and entry seven of an eight-way bounded range writes [1303,1304,1305,1306], readable heap entry five returns [103,203,303,403], texture heap entry seven loads/samples [100,110,120,130] and gathers packed 0x828c8c82, writable integer texture heap entry three stores exact [1003,1004,1005,1006], regular sampler heap entry one samples [15,15,15,15], comparison sampler entry one returns [1,1,1,1], bounded comparison-texture entries six/seven return distinct [0,0,0,0]/[1,1,1,1], and RWStructuredBuffer<uint2>[2] writes exact [600,700,601,701,602,702,603,703]. The focused descriptor-indexing row now covers two-, four-, and eight-way ranges plus scalar, two-component, four-component nested, raw, structured, sampled, comparison, and writable paths.
The audit covers reports emitted by the focused invocation; it is not an exhaustive title corpus.

The source-staged matrix proves exact sample/load, GetDimensions, and readback for 1D, 1D-array, 2D, 2D-array, 3D, cube, cube-array, and 2D MSAA textures plus UAV stores for 1D/1D-array/2D/2D-array/3D. Height-one Metal 2D backing additionally proves nonzero 1D/1D-array mips; MSAA UAV stores and broader operation coverage remain tracked separately.

Mip-1 scalar/array 1D sampling and GetDimensions pass over height-one Metal 2D backing; a combined level/bias/gradient/static-offset lane returns 0x14323232; pixel-stage clamped/unclamped CalculateLevelOfDetail returns exact 0x3f800000 while mixed vertex/pixel regular/depth 2D/1D/1D-array comparison sampling sums to exact 0x40800000; all standard min/mag/mip and anisotropic filters return exact values; clamp/wrap/mirror/border/mirror-once and the three Metal-representable border colors return exact values; native depth sample_compare returns exact point/linear/static-offset, level, gradient, bias, 2D-array, cube, and cube-array results; color/depth gather and their static-offset forms return exact four-component neighborhoods; unrepresentable dynamic-border and min/max reduction samplers remain fail-closed with the exact 0xdeadbeef sentinel; and the resource matrix creates a five-mip 1D array without a Metal assertion. Broader comparison address modes and non-pixel graphics-stage combinations remain in the exhaustive row.

Native depth 2D-array, cube, and cube-array SampleCmpLevelZero return exact float bits [0x3f800000,0x3f800000,0x3f800000], with exact sum 0x40400000; vertex/pixel logical Texture1D and Texture1DArray comparisons contribute to a separate exact 4.0 sum; and the complete comparison address matrix returns exact clamp [0,1], opaque-white border [1,1], wrap [1,0], mirror [0,1], and mirror-once [0,1] pairs. Geometry, hull, domain, amplification, and mesh-stage comparison combinations remain in the exhaustive row.

The source-staged R32_UINT Texture2D<uint> Load/GetDimensions case proves metadata element type propagation into an integer Metal texture view; the expanded typed-family row covers signed, writable, normalized, packed 10/11-bit, scalar 64-bit, writable MSAA 2/4/8-sample texture breadth with exact resolve readback, and pixel-stage GetRenderTargetSamplePosition/GetRenderTargetSampleCount lowering with custom sample positions, pixel SampleIndex/Coverage system-value lowering, and exact sample-mask readback, while broader multisample typed combinations remain exhaustive work.

The focused source-staged matrix proves R32_SINT and R32_UINT read views plus an R32_UINT writable view with exact readback; R16/RG16/RGBA8, normalized/packed, and scalar 64-bit breadth is covered by the expanded row while MSAA-UAV forms remain exhaustive work.

The 42-case source-staged matrix proves R32/R16/RG16/RGBA8 signed, unsigned, floating, and normalized access; packed R10G10B10A2 UINT/UNORM and R11G11B10 FLOAT; and scalar signed/unsigned 64-bit R32G32_UINT reads/writes with exact logical or storage-bit readback. The focused writable-MSAA source probe additionally proves 2/4/8-sample and array stores, loads, resolves, programmable sample-position options, and a graphics-stage MSAA path with exact values; broader multisample typed combinations remain in the exhaustive row.

Profile phase5-reflection-fix1 validates the runtime-generated MSL binding manifest against CBV b0, SRV t0/t1, UAV u0, and sampler s0, with deterministic invalid-binding negatives. Metal Shader Converter reflection remains an optional cross-provider input rather than the sole reflection source.

Profile phase5-eval-final executes pixel Texture2DMS.GetSamplePosition, render-target sample position/count, SV_SampleIndex, SV_Coverage, and centroid/sample/snapped attribute evaluation against exact per-sample and color readbacks. The standalone native Metal 4 vertex-value control records the Apple M4/Apple9 negative boundary (`supports_apple10=false`, constant `[255,0,0,255]`, vertex_value `[0,0,0,0]`), and an ABI-matched direct D3D12 graphics probe rejects the opcode-137 PSO with `unsupported_intrinsics=12`, `unsupported_opcodes=0`, and `0x80004005`; these supply no positive AttributeAtVertex readback, and broader non-constant interpolation/stage combinations remain in the exhaustive row.

The conservative-raster reference provider proves SV_InnerCoverage for one 64x64 triangle with exact fully-covered and edge-only pixel counts. Other conservative rasterization edge rules, depths, MSAA, VRS, lines, and broader stage combinations remain in the exhaustive row.

The SM6.0 pixel shader discards the left half of a 64x64 full-screen triangle at SV_Position.x < 32 and returns exactly 1,024 surviving nonzero target words. Other discard control-flow shapes and interactions with depth, MSAA, UAV writes, and derivatives remain in the exhaustive row.

The native Metal intersection_query path proves a compute-stage RayQuery over a two-instance triangle/procedural-AABB TLAS, including exact hit readback, candidate/committed state and instance-contribution accessors, direct acceleration-structure/contribution-table binding, procedural commit/status behavior, an R16 indexed triangle BLAS variant, and fail-closed rejection of an unsupported ray flag. Contribution-table aliasing with an external UAV counter, broader procedural geometry, ray-generation table breadth, state-object growth, shader tables, mixed geometry, serialization, and broader DXR stage/resource combinations remain in the exhaustive row.

The host-specific native libmetalirconverter provider now executes exact ray-generation DispatchRaysIndex/Dimensions, triangle hit InstanceID/InstanceIndex/HitKind/RayFlags, primitive/geometry indices, RayTMin/RayTCurrent, world/object ray vectors, and diagonal object/world transforms. It also executes IgnoreHit on one triangle path (which reaches the miss shader) and AcceptHitAndEndSearch on another (which reaches the closest-hit path with its accepted-payload marker). Full table counts/strides/offsets, recursion, local-root combinations, SER, OMM, and portable compiler-object coverage remain open.

The exact vertex-stage proof covers SV_StartVertexLocation and SV_StartInstanceLocation for one non-indexed DrawInstanced command with nonzero start values; the two-view SV_ViewID replay has its own exact row. Indexed, mesh/amplification, and broader extended-command-information combinations remain in the exhaustive row.

The exact compute fixture covers i32 and float TempRegLoad/TempRegStore, bool and half overloads, plus the float MinPrecXRegLoad/Store pointer/component path with bounded private storage. Vector overloads, dynamic indexable min-precision addressing, and cross-stage matrices remain in the exhaustive opcode row.

The exact two-view array-layer replay covers SV_ViewID values 0 and 1 with view-instance masks 0x1 and 0x2. Broader view counts, viewport/render-target location permutations, non-vertex stages, and interactions with mesh, tessellation, VRS, and MSAA remain in the exhaustive row.

The exact Apple M4/Metal 4 native mesh provider covers 64-byte, 128-byte, and 256-byte SM6.5 amplification-to-mesh payloads, including a 64-thread group, direct and GPU-only indirect dispatch, one triangle, two render-target-array layers, depth/blend/wireframe variants, stage CBV/SRV/UAV/sampler bindings, and PIPELINE_STATISTICS1. Additional payload sizes, mesh output counts/topologies, other thread-group shapes, barriers, resource ranges, VRS, and amplification patterns remain in the exhaustive row; the native libmetalirconverter cache provider is host-specific and is not a portable compiler-object provider.

Strict closeout accounting remains open at 257/280 required opcode rows observed, 23 open, and 32 reserved/not-applicable: opcode 109 CycleCounterLegacy; opcode 137 AttributeAtVertex; opcodes 238-253 Work Graph/node operations; and opcodes 262-289 SER/HitObject operations. AttributeAtVertex now has an exact ABI mapping and a native Apple9 hardware-boundary negative, but no positive readback. CycleCounterLegacy now has an exact native Metal 4.0 clock-rejection negative; an ABI-matched direct DXIL probe records `unsupported_intrinsics=1`, `unsupported_opcodes=0`, and `CreateComputePipelineState=0x80004005`, with both DXIL lowerers failing closed before PSO creation. The descending SER/HitObject pass now has typed GPU-provider positive readbacks for opcodes 262, 265, 266, and 269-280. Under an ABI-matched PE/Unix bridge and `METAL_SHADER_CONVERTER=/nonexistent`, the bounded triangle provider returns exact state, ray-vector, transform, and scalar results; the standalone legacy conversion path remains separately fail-closed. Rows 264, 267-268, and 288-289 remain open pending exact FromRayQueryWithAttrs, invocation/reordering, local-root-table, and attribute behavior. Work Graph/node and the remaining SER/HitObject positive behavior remain incomplete, as does the broader stable SM5.x-DXBC through SM6.9-DXIL opcode/intrinsic, graphics-stage, texture-dimension, multi-counter, cache, and compiler-session matrix.
